text:
sam: Heads-up: spotted a small but sharp token billing spike at 03:20 UTC linked to WebSocket clients. Notable pattern: client sees a clean close, then immediately reconnects and tokens double for same logical conversation id.

lina: Do the reconnections have different session_ids or the same?

sam: Same conversation_id but new socket/session_id. Example trace: conv=conv_221, old_sid=sid-A, new_sid=sid-B, server emitted terminal chunk then re-emitted last few tokens on the resumed socket.

ben: That sounds like a half-close ack race. Which component sent the close? edge or proxy?

sam: Proxy initiated an idle close (FIN) during a brief long GC on the edge host. Edge processed FIN but our ack path didn't reach proxy before proxy recycled the socket and re-proxied to a different upstream. Client retried the WS attach; upstream replayed tail of stream because it didn't mark the conversation terminal.

kavi: Telemetry shows tail_replay_count spiked concurrently with ws_close_inflight>0. We have a guard that marks conversation terminal only after durable write to stream_state, but that write was delayed by GC pause. Proxy closed early.

maya: From Console ops: a few enterprise customers complained about "message duplication" in UI and saw quota drops. Need to show duplicates in token breakdown vs genuine new tokens.

lina: Can you paste the minimal reproduction? maybe simulate a paused write path while proxy closes socket.

sam: Repro (conceptual):
```
# open WS, send a message that triggers long model response
# simulate edge GC: sleep 200ms before persisting stream_state
# meanwhile proxy idle timeout kicks and rebinds socket
# client reconnects, server replays tail because stream_state wasn't committed
```

ben: Short-term mitigations? Increase proxy idle timeout or make close wait for outstanding state ack. Longer-term: make stream_state writes synchronous for terminal markers or add idempotent replay token on resume.

kavi: Increasing proxy idle timeout to 1s eliminated replays in local stress tests. But that increases number of idle sockets (cost). Alternative: send an explicit "closing: pending" control frame that proxies treat as sticky and won't rebind for 500ms. That requires proxy change but cheaper resource-wise.

maya: Product note: customers will prefer non-duplication even at minor socket cost. We should treat as P1 for billing accuracy for paid tiers.

lina: Ops, can we snapshot which customers hit this? Need to notify them if they were double-billed.

ops-bot: @billing-bot running query: SELECT conv_id, sum(duplicate_tokens) FROM billing_events WHERE timestamp BETWEEN 2026-03-21T03:15 AND 2026-03-21T03:25 GROUP BY conv_id;

ben: Also add a console metric: "ws_replay_tail_tokens" so we can plot and correlate with proxy idle closes. Maya can we add that to per-tenant token chart?

maya: Yes. UX: show a tiny red overlay in token chart labeled "replayed tokens" with hover showing sample traces. I'll add to backlog.

kavi: For a quick fix I'll push proxy idle_time bump to 1s in staging and deploy an edge change to flush terminal marker to disk before replying 200/close, with a best-effort sync that times out at 300ms. If sync fails we still close but set a replay_protection flag on resume requests for 10s.

lina: Sounds reasonable. Please also add a log field on resume requests: "previous_terminal_seq" so we can compare and dedupe in billing later.

sam: After pushing the proxy idle_time bump to staging, replay counts dropped ~97% in synthetic traffic. Edge best-effort flush reduced the remaining.

ops-bot: @deploy-bot canary: proxy-idle-timeout-bump v1 -> 3/12 hosts

ben: We should create an alert: if ws_replay_tail_tokens > threshold AND ws_close_inflight_rate > 0.5 over 10m then page. Also add audit to billing pipeline to subtract known replayed tokens when confirmed.

kavi: I'll write up a small RFC for a durable terminal ACK and idempotent resume token. Will include cost analysis for socket idle time vs memory.

maya: I'll coordinate console changes and a customer-facing note for any tenants who saw an impact.

lina: Thanks team. Plan: short-term proxy idle bump + best-effort flush. Medium-term durable terminal ack + resume idempotency + console replay metric. Postmortem + customer comms after metrics stabilize.

sam: TL;DR: root cause = proxy idle close during edge write pause -> conversation terminal not durable -> tail replay on reconnect -> duplicate tokens billed. Mitigations deployed to staging/canary.

ops-bot: Canary started -> proxy-idle-timeout-bump v1 -> 3/12 hosts

ben: Also add unit tests in streaming runtime for simulated GC pause + proxy close.
